title: Review disputes (eval/reviews/<date>.json)
description: Every score the scorer and the independent reviewer disagreed on in one review, with each score's cited anchor and evidence ids, the tie-break (or why there was none), and the score that stands. The middle-of-three rule is in method/REVIEW.md. Agreed scores are not listed: they are recorded as reviewed_on and reviewer_note on the judgement entry.

date.description: The review date. Must match the file name.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads (for example a field from an older system). Kept as is.

item_id.description: The judgement entry: '<role id>/<D1, D2 or D4>' for eval/judgements.json (for example 'acme:4100001/D2'), '<D3, D5 or D7>/<organisation id or default>' or 'D6/<location class>' for eval/profile-dimensions.json.

date.description: Optional; defaults to the file's date.

tie_break.description: The second fresh reviewer's blind score, or a record that there was none (never a made-up score).

stands.description: The score that stands in the judgement file.

decided_by.description: middle_of_three: the middle of the scorer's, the reviewer's and the tie-break scores (method/REVIEW.md). awaiting_tie_break: no tie-break yet, so the entry stays unreviewed. earlier_rule: decided before the middle-of-three rule (for example history imported from an older campaign); say how in note.

anchor.description: The rubric anchor the score claims to meet, for example 'D3 anchor 1: first-degree contact, has not seen the work'.

evidence.description: The evidence ids cited. An empty list means 'no evidence'.

by.description: Who gave it: scorer, reviewer, tie-break reviewer, or a person.
